Welcome back to another episode of The Download! This week, we break down our top session recommendations for Microsoft Build 2026, including keynotes and practical AI workflows. We also cover massive shifts in the ecosystem: Andrej Karpathy joining Anthropic, Deno 2.8's major performance upgrades, and Bun's unexpected shift from Zig to Rust. Plus, stay tuned to see how GitHub Copilot remote control lets you close your laptop and take your sessions on the go. 

#GitHubCopilot #MicrosoftBuild #Anthropic 

— CHAPTERS —  

00:00 Welcome to the download 
00:36 Microsoft Build 2026 watchlist 
02:36 Andrej Karpathy joins Anthropic 
03:03 Deno 2.8 performance updates 
03:53 Microsoft releases Azure Linux 4.0 
04:31 Bun moves from Zig to Rust 
04:56 Open source project of the week: text-to-cad 
05:29 GitHub Copilot remote control is GA 
06:15 New gear at the GitHub Shop 
06:46 Outro 

— RESOURCES —  

Register for Build: https://gh.io/microsoft-build BRK245 — Peter Steinberger: https://build.
title: The Download: Microsoft Build 2026, Copilot remote control, Deno 2.8, Bun & more

description:
What does open source maintenance actually look like once a project starts to scale?

In this Open Source Friday stream, Ayushman Bhattacharya shares how Pollinations.ai built the systems behind a fast-growing open source AI project. We’ll dig into contributor workflows, paid quests, AI-assisted PR review, app submission pipelines, model curation, and what maintainers really spend their day doing.
title: Open Source Friday: Building the Contributor Pipeline at Pollinations.ai
